cosmos.base.query.v1beta1.PageRequest.title:
PageRequest is to be embedded in gRPC request messages for efficient
pagination. Ex:

count_total.description:
count_total is set to true  to indicate that the result set should include
a count of the total number of items available for pagination in UIs.
count_total is only respected when offset is used. It is ignored when key
is set.

key.description:
key is a value returned in PageResponse.next_key to begin
querying the next page most efficiently. Only one of offset or key
should be set.

limit.description:
limit is the total number of results to be returned in the result page.
If left empty it will default to a value to be set by each app.

offset.description:
offset is a numeric offset that can be used when key is unavailable.
It is less efficient than using key. Only one of offset or key should
be set.

reverse.description: reverse is set to true if results are to be returned in the descending order.

next_key.description:
next_key is the key to be passed to PageRequest.key to
query the next page most efficiently. It will be empty if
there are no more results.

total.title:
total is total number of results available if PageRequest.count_total
was set, its value is undefined otherwise

smartnodes.verify.v1.NodeRecord.description: NodeRecord is what verification knows about one VPN node.

consecutive_fails.description: consecutive_fails counts failed rounds since the last pass.

jail_count.description: jail_count counts how many times the node has been jailed.

jailed.description:
jailed nodes are not probed and are left out of client listings until
the operator unjails them.

jailed_at.description: jailed_at is the block time, in Unix seconds, of the last jailing.

last_pass_round.description: last_pass_round is the last round the node passed, or 0.

last_round.description: last_round is the last round in which reports for the node were tallied.

passes.description: passes and fails count every decided round.

pending_round.description:
pending_round is the last round the node earned a reward share in that
has not been turned into an amount yet, or 0.

pending_weight.description: pending_weight is the node's weight in pending_round's budget.

reward_balance.description:
reward_balance is the reward the operator can claim, in the base unit of
the staking token. It never expires.

reward_paid.description: reward_paid is the total reward claimed so far.

slashed.description:
slashed is the total bond burned for proven tampering, in the base unit
of the staking token.

tamper_rounds.description:
tamper_rounds counts rounds in which every assigned prober reported
tampering.

verified.description: verified is true if the node passed the last round it was tallied in.

smartnodes.verify.v1.Params.description: Params defines the parameters for the module.

blocks_per_year.description: blocks_per_year turns the yearly rates above into per-round amounts.

node_share_bps.description:
node_share_bps is the share of each release that goes to verified
nodes, in basis points. The rest goes to the prober fund.

pool_release_bps_per_year.description:
pool_release_bps_per_year is the share of the node rewards pool's
remaining balance released per year, in basis points.

report_reward.description:
report_reward is paid to a prober for each accepted report, in the base
unit of the staking token, from the prober fund.

reward_cap_bps_per_year.description:
reward_cap_bps_per_year caps a node's reward per year, as a share of
its tier's minimum bond, in basis points.

reward_retention_rounds.description:
reward_retention_rounds is how many rounds a round's reward budget is
kept. A share not fixed within this time is forfeited to the pool.

unjail_wait_seconds.description:
unjail_wait_seconds is how long a jailed node must wait before its
operator may return it to service.

prober_ids.description: prober_ids are the probers assigned to the node, if it is selected.

selected.description: selected is true if the node is probed this round.

smartnodes.verify.v1.QueryParamsResponse.description: QueryParamsResponse is response type for the Query/Params RPC method.

params.description: params holds all the parameters of this module.

smartnodes.verify.v1.QueryRewardPoolResp.description:
QueryRewardPoolResponse defines the QueryRewardPoolResponse message.
Amounts are in the base unit of the staking token.

address.description: address is the pool's account address.

balance.description: balance is what the pool account holds.

owed.description:
owed is the part of the balance already earned by nodes and waiting to
be claimed.

round_budget.description: round_budget is the current round's budget for verified nodes.

active_probers.description: active_probers is the number of probers in the active set.

next_round_height.description: next_round_height is the block at which the next round starts.

round.description: round is the current round number, or 0 before the first round.

seed.description: seed is the round's random seed, in hex.

start_height.description: start_height is the block at which the round started.
